notes.title: 宇峻奧汀舉辦「30週年經典遊戲節」於Steam平台推出限時優惠
notes.notes: [p]宇峻奧汀歡慶成立30週年，盛大推出「30週年經典遊戲節」！即日起至8月4日止，旗下歷代《三國群英傳》、《幻想三國誌》、及《聖石傳說EX》等經典作品，於Steam平台推出限時優惠，邀請玩家們一同回味經典、重燃熱血！[/p][p] [/p][p]此外，橫跨二十載的經典系列作品《三國群英傳Online》，日前也宣布與CAPCOM名作《元祖洛克人》展開跨界聯動，攜手共慶週年盛典。同時，《東方幻想ECLIPSE》也推出「聯動貼圖」和「台灣啤酒」聯動活動，為30週年慶典再添話題亮點！[/p][p] [/p][p]在迎向三十週年的特別時刻，為感謝玩家長年以來的支持與陪伴，宇峻奧汀特別推出「30 週年經典遊戲節」。即日 起至 8 月 4 日止，於 Steam 平台推出旗下多款經典作品的限時優惠，折扣最高可達 5 折。包括經典系列作《三國群英傳》、《幻想三國誌》和《聖石傳說 EX》等作品，無論是懷舊回味，或是初來乍到的玩家，現在正是珍藏宇峻奧汀經典作品的絕佳時機！[/p]

notes.title: 《Antivine》Launch on December 21st !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/768b228793d5b2f4f7b7828f18728d62d533b86f.png[/img]

[b]《Antivine》will Launch on December 21st, language support includes Traditional-Chinese, Simplified-Chinese, English, Japnaese and Korean. The develop team also released gameplay images which show it is a puzzle game giving players an unique experience. [/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/996a355a4cd90749bd1745266c02f79f2808ff9d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/bca6e3aa14a55416986bbdcf991de6478a76a212.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/cdd017586d09f1b4117fb70a778e997ea3459dd6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/407f2ce1493ec53096ea4089e50503ce4fc8c681.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/868364ab601c9523500fedda9aff51cd7a34a365.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/07d10d738c1560d2e7fd78dde0d7d0399f58c764.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/7b86ca8cb23217ce95acc1bb93711593776cfa45.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/21d8629b4df271ae0933526344de44ff22238932.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/0dfc736efe8713b9ff4af6e96cac02189dad362b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559218/3a4d1923f9c85013cbac486b9c01d04c0786a8c7.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]《Antivine》is a game describing an unique boy looking for the truth of Treeman. People started to grow branches on their bodies, and died as Treeman. Some said the truth can be found at the other side of the world. 

Senhsu the young boy was not accepted by his people because he did not have the sign. He started his journey with a girl Mumei, and by changing his way of thinking, they cleared all the barriers and found the answer.[/b]
